talleres.intro:
Where hands tell stories

Every Fely Campo piece is born close by. In our atelier and two small workshops in the sierra, skilled hands transform each fabric with time, precision and sensitivity. Behind those hands are women, craft and territory.

parrafos: At felycampo.com we want to help you choose the finest wedding gowns and eveningwear, exquisite luxury prêt-à-porter looks perfect for any occasion.

At our new Atelier in Madrid you'll find the latest from our runway collections, and you can also experience the unique process of creating a made-to-measure gown, whether for a party, a wedding, or any other event.
If you're looking for your wedding dress, our Bridal Atelier in Salamanca is ready to welcome you for a truly unique experience.

At the Fely Campo Fiesta stores in Salamanca and Oviedo, whether you're the mother of the bride, a guest or a bridesmaid for any event, our stylists will personally guide you to find the perfect dress.
You'll also find us through our wide network of stockists, both nationally and internationally.
Fely Campo brings the elegance of its design into everyday life with the prêt-à-porter line, available at our Salamanca store.
Come and discover the magic of Fely Campo in person.

visitaAtelier.texto: Fely Campo was born in Salamanca as a women's fashion house in 1997. Specialised in party and bridal collections, the house has become a benchmark in the industry, both at home and abroad, thanks to its commitment to quality and timeless design.
